title: Creeper Totems
description: You can make the texture of the totem in the game from 4 different creepers: Rainbow - Classic - Zombie - Venerable.
body:
You can make the texture of the totem in the game from 4 different creepers: 

## **Rainbow ->** 
![Rainbow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68b2765ad330fee8313caf7340aaf30b2adcc4d8.png)

## **Classic ->** 
![Classic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/98535281db8517b532533a0f7e80dda40353098e.png)

## **Zombie ->** 
![Zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2c8a83f0d6709f17f3695491be21f004baa8d66.png)

## **Venerable ->** 
![Venerable](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0fee8f90fc017389f3ab7aca33c8d8e142eb1f09.png)

Determine the creeper texture you want and download your resource pack according to the title written under the version number in the version tab.
